title: the installer-lives-in-recovery proof counts tracked files at the old address and runs install through bash_script_argv
intention: The proof's files-are-home tooth counts tracked files at the old address (git ls-files), and its install tooth runs bin/cmd/install through cairn.tools.base.script_argv.bash_script_argv.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: akiendell: cairn/machines/installer holds only __pycache__/ (git ls-files over it is empty) and tooth_files_are_home reds 'still exists'; tooth_install_runs_from_the_new_home reds OSError WinError 193 from subprocess.run([bin/cmd/install]) at proof line 74
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 8: a proof red on one box for a stale cache and a launcher, not for the move it measures, is not measuring the component; CP4 resolves the chafe.
how: In tooth_files_are_home replace the .exists() check with git ls-files over the old address returning nothing; in tooth_install_runs_from_the_new_home build the argv with bash_script_argv(ROOT/bin/cmd/install) + ['--dry-run']. The proof stays one file; red first is the existing proof red on akiendell HEAD.

clauses.claim: with only an untracked __pycache__ at cairn/machines/installer, tooth_files_are_home is green; a tracked file there still reds it
tooth_install_runs_from_the_new_home is green on a Windows box and stays green on a posix box

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: akiendell: cairn/machines/installer holds only __pycache__/ (git ls-files over it is empty) and tooth_files_are_home reds 'still exists'; tooth_install_runs_from_the_new_home reds OSError WinError 193 from subprocess.run([bin/cmd/install]) at proof line 74
measured.how: ran the proof with the venv python; ls and git ls-files over cairn/machines/installer; read proof lines 52-79
